edbDesc: A hyperboloid is a quadric, a type of surface in three dimensions. A hyperboloid of revolution of one sheet can be obtained by revolving a hyperbola around its semi-minor axis. A hyperboloid of revolution of two sheets can be obtained by revolving a hyperbola around its focal axis. Hyperboloid structures are used in construction - they can be built with straight steel beams. Examples include cooling towers.
title: Hyperboloid
